channel.title: Hypewire
channel.description: What people are talking about in AI, entertainment, gaming and tech, refreshed daily.

item.title: Sunrise on the Reaping opens to $120 million in the US and $225 million worldwide
item.description: The Hunger Games prequel opened to an estimated $120 million in North America and $225 million worldwide, AP reports.

item.title: GTA VI makes $3.79 billion on day one, Rockstar says
item.description: Rockstar says Grand Theft Auto VI took $3.79 billion in first-day worldwide retail sales, and 32.5 million copies were pre-sold.

item.title: Anthropic mathematician says Claude helped him prove the Riemann Hypothesis
item.description: Anthropic mathematician Levent Alpöge says he proved the Riemann Hypothesis with help from Claude, Bloomberg reports.

item.title: Nvidia opens a CEO search as its board rules out Jensen Huang's return
item.description: Nvidia's board has hired Heidrick & Struggles to find a new CEO and says it does not plan to reinstate Huang, after shares fell 14% on Friday.

item.title: Questions grow over Anthropic's IPO as its shares keep sliding
item.description: The FT asks whether Anthropic and its bankers got the IPO wrong, after weak trading and a quick use of the option to sell extra shares.

item.title: Startup says AI agents designed a whole new CPU architecture
item.description: Architect Labs says AI agents designed Frostbite, a processor with a new instruction set, which it says beat a conventional core on efficiency in simulation.

item.title: Netflix's The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth starts a two-week IMAX run
item.description: The Netflix film plays in IMAX cinemas from November 25 for two weeks before it premieres on the service on December 23.

item.title: Cisco Expressway flaw exploited to break into internal networks
item.description: Attackers used a critical Cisco Expressway flaw, CVE-2026-76466, to get root access on devices and move into internal networks, Help Net Security reports.

item.title: Trump and Xi agreed humans should stay in military AI decisions, Bessent says
item.description: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent says the two leaders agreed that humans should stay involved in major military decisions that use AI.

item.title: TSMC and Samsung reportedly pause some chip shipments to China
item.description: TrendForce reports TSMC and Samsung have suspended some chip shipments to Chinese customers after tighter US export rules.

item.title: Blade Runner 2099 arrives on Prime Video with all eight episodes on November 25
item.description: The eight-episode Blade Runner series, starring Michelle Yeoh and Hunter Schafer, streams on Prime Video from November 25.

item.title: Switch 2 Mario Kart World bundle drops to $499 for Black Friday
item.description: Amazon and Walmart are selling the Switch 2 with Mario Kart World for $499, $50 below its $549 price, for a limited time.

item.title: Optimizely supply-chain attack put a card skimmer on 178 brands' sites
item.description: Malicious code in Optimizely's JavaScript ran on 178 brands' websites on November 16, skimming card data and swapping crypto addresses, reports say.

item.title: SpaceX's $74 billion AI data-centre plans raise questions over power bills
item.description: Fortune reports SpaceX has about $74 billion of AI facilities planned in Texas and Arizona, and locals want to know who pays for the grid.

item.title: Disney's animated Hexed leads the Thanksgiving week cinema openings
item.description: Disney's Hexed opens wide on November 25, alongside Hershey, Bitter Christmas and A24's Club Kid, with Focker In-Law following on November 27.

item.title: AI-led sell-off deepens, dragging Bitcoin to a 20-week low near $60,000
item.description: After the Nasdaq's 5.28% fall on November 20, the tech sell-off has spread, with Bitcoin dropping to about $60,000, TechJuice reports.

item.title: Meta reconsiders its 2030 net-zero goal as AI pushes emissions up
item.description: Meta says it is re-evaluating its net-zero milestones as its AI infrastructure grows, Ars Technica reports.

item.title: Steam Awards add a Hall of Fame vote between ten past Games of the Year
item.description: Nominations for the tenth Steam Awards run until November 30, with a new Hall of Fame pitting past winners against each other.

item.title: VMware vCenter zero-day was used for months before Broadcom's patch
item.description: Mandiant says a group it calls ARMORY CASTLE used vCenter flaw CVE-2026-123890 from September to make itself a sign-in administrator.

item.title: I Play Rocky takes second with $9.3 million in its wide expansion
item.description: Peter Farrelly's film about the making of Rocky expanded from 29 to 2,477 cinemas and took second with $9.3 million, AP reports.

item.title: Customer-service AI startup Sierra is reported to raise $1.75 billion
item.description: Sierra, which makes AI agents for customer service, has reportedly raised $1.75 billion at a $30 billion valuation.

item.title: GTA VI gets its first big patch, 1.002.002, with no patch notes
item.description: Rockstar's update 1.002.002 is rolling out by region, at about 600MB on PS5, but no patch notes have been published, PlayStation LifeStyle reports.

item.title: iPhone Air 2 dummy units point to a new dual-camera design
item.description: Dummy models said to show the iPhone Air 2 have a dual rear camera, while the standard iPhone 18 looks largely unchanged, reports say.

item.title: The Rings of Power season 3 finale lands on Prime Video on November 24
item.description: Amazon's Lord of the Rings series ends its third season with two episodes at 9 p.m. on November 24, TVLine's schedule lists.

item.title: JPMorgan, Visa and Mastercard confirm vendor breaches after n0n leak claim
item.description: The three firms have confirmed breaches at vendors after the n0n group's leak claim, with names and emails exposed, The Layman Security reports.

item.title: Java4Shell flaw lets a crafted text string take over some Java servers
item.description: CVE-2026-114938 lets a crafted Base64 string corrupt Java's memory on servers with AVX-512 chips, which can lead to code execution.

item.title: OpenRouter drops three AI providers after researchers find stolen keys
item.description: OpenRouter removed three inference providers and 125 endpoints from its zero-data-retention list after Dragos found compromised providers.

item.title: You Can See Everything comes to digital rental after a near-$100 million run
item.description: Nathan Fielder's documentary arrives to rent or buy on November 24 while still in cinemas, where it made $2.5 million last weekend.

item.title: Cleverbridge says hackers copied card numbers and CVVs from its platform
item.description: E-commerce platform Cleverbridge, whose clients include Red Hat and Sony, says a third party copied stored payment card data, including CVVs.

item.title: OpenAI suggests next-word prediction as a shared measure of AI progress
item.description: OpenAI chief scientist Jakub Pachocki published internal perplexity results and proposed it as a common yardstick across AI labs.

item.title: Peter Berg's football drama The Mosquito Bowl premieres on Netflix
item.description: The Mosquito Bowl, a football drama set after Pearl Harbor, premieres on Netflix on November 25.

item.title: GTA VI players find a Super Mario nod with brick breaking and hats
item.description: A player's video reportedly shows a GTA VI hallucination scene that references Super Mario, including brick breaking and wearable hats.

item.title: Peacock's DIG, with Amy Poehler as an archaeologist, is out in full
item.description: All ten episodes of DIG, from Amy Poehler and Michael Schur, arrived on Peacock on November 23.

item.title: NGINX fixes five critical flaws, including an HTTP/2 bug from 2015
item.description: NGINX patched five code-execution flaws rated 9.2 on November 18, and one HTTP/2 bug now has a public proof-of-concept exploit.

item.title: Microsoft says an Entra Connect Health flaw was used to take tenant data
item.description: Microsoft has disclosed that attackers exploited a flaw in its Entra Connect Health API to reach tenant metadata, including admin emails, reports say.

item.title: The Hunting Wives season 2 arrives on Netflix on Thanksgiving Day
item.description: All eight episodes of The Hunting Wives season 2, with Brittany Snow and Malin Akerman, stream on Netflix on November 26.

item.title: Game Pass adds Motorslice and Sniper Ghost Warrior, with Arkheron on day one
item.description: Xbox Game Pass adds Motorslice and Sniper Ghost Warrior Contracts 2 on November 24, and Arkheron launches in Game Preview on November 27.

item.title: Persona 6 has no date, but a website update fuels Game Awards trailer talk
item.description: Atlus says Persona 6 has no release date yet, while an update to its web domain has fans expecting a trailer at The Game Awards on December 10.

item.title: Nintendo's winter catalogue gives a first glimpse of Pokemon Winds and Waves
item.description: Nintendo's Japanese Winter Catalogue includes a short description of Pokemon Winds and Waves, promising islands and a vast ocean to explore.

item.title: Final Fantasy VII Revelation has been rated by the ESRB
item.description: The third part of the Final Fantasy VII remake series has received an ESRB rating, My Nintendo News reports.

item.title: Elastic agrees to buy AI agent tracing startup HoneyHive
item.description: Elastic has agreed to acquire HoneyHive, which makes tools for tracing and evaluating AI agents. Terms were not disclosed.

item.title: Ebenezer drops 60% in its second weekend but passes $78 million worldwide
item.description: Johnny Depp's Christmas film made $7.7 million in its second weekend, down about 60%, and has $32.5 million in the US, AP reports.

item.title: The Wolf Among Us Remastered is set for November 29 on the original Switch
item.description: Telltale's remaster of The Wolf Among Us has an eShop date of November 29 on the original Switch, after an earlier delay.

item.title: The full Mario Kart DS soundtrack is now on Nintendo Music
item.description: Nintendo has added all 78 tracks of the Mario Kart DS soundtrack to its Nintendo Music app for Switch Online members.
